Name: Shelomith, Son of Shimei
Summary: Son of Shimei, named with Haziel and Haran as chief of the fathers of Laadan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:9: Son of Shimei, named with Haziel and Haran as chief of the fathers of Laadan.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shelomith stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
